text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian claimed victory in the Japan 
Cup. Amid thunderous applause, she and 
Hishi Amazon swore to each other that they 
would keep running to the ends of the 
earth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Narita Brian headed to 
the hospital to see Biwa Hayahide. 
However, she was nowhere to be found.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide had fully recovered from her 
injury and was training hard. The two 
promised to face each other in the 
upcoming Arima Kinen.
